column4: iṣṭavarṇagandharasasparśaṃ vidhivihitamannapānaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇisaṃjñakānāṃ prāṇamācakṣate kuśalāḥ pratyakṣaphaladarśanāt tadindhanā hyantaragneḥ sthitiḥ tat sattvamūrjyati taccharīradhātuvyūhabalavarṇendriyaprasādakaraṃ yathoktamupasevyamānaṃ viparītamahitāya saṃpadyate //

tat svabhāvādudaktaṃ kledayati, lavaṇaṃ viṣyandayati, kṣāraḥ pācayati, madhu saṃdadhāti, sarpiḥ snehayati, kṣīraṃ jīvayati, māṃsaṃ bṛṃhayati, rasaḥ prīṇayati, surā jarjarīkaroti, śīdhuravadhamati, drākṣāsavo dīpayati, phāṇitamācinoti, dadhi śophaṃ janayati, piṇyākaśākaṃ glapayati, prabhūtāntarmalo māṣasūpaḥ, dṛṣṭiśukraghnaḥ kṣāraḥ, prāyaḥ pittalamamlamanyatra dāḍimāmalakāt, prāyaḥ śleṣmalaṃ madhuramanyatra madhunaḥ purāṇācca śāliṣaṣṭikayavagodhūmāt, prāyastikaṃ vātalamavṛṣyaṃ cānyatra vegāgrāmṛtāpaṭolapatrāt, prāyaḥ kaṭukaṃ vātalamavṛṣyaṃ cānyatra pippalīviśvabheṣajāt//
jīvano bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ snigdhaḥ sthairyakaro guruḥ//
atha śamīdhānyavargaḥ--- kaṣāyamadhuro rūkṣaḥ śītaḥ pāke kaṭurlaghuḥ/
vṛṣyaḥ paraṃ vātaharaḥ snigdhoṣṇo madhuro guruḥ/
balyo bahumalaḥ puṃstvaṃ māṣaḥ śīghraṃ dadāti ca//
teṣāṃ masūraḥ saṃgrāhī kalāyo vātalaḥ param//
śimbī rūkṣā kaṣāyā ca koṣṭhe vātaprakopinī/
na ca vṛṣyā na cakṣuṣyā viṣṭabhya ca vipacyate//
haṃsaḥ krauñco balākā ca bakaḥ kāraṇḍavaḥ plavaḥ//
lāvādyo vaiṣkiro vargaḥ pratudā jāṅgalā mṛgāḥ//
kaṣāyo viśado rūkṣaḥ śītaḥ pāke kaṭurlaghuḥ//
snigdhoṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ vṛṣyaṃ māhiṣaṃ guru tarpaṇam//
caṭakānāṃ ca yāni syuraṇḍāni ca hitāni ca/
vṛṣyā snigdhā ca śītā ca madaghnī cāpyupodikā/
kaulakaṃ kārkaśaṃ naimbaṃ śākaṃ pārpaṭakaṃ ca yat//
śākaṃ guru ca rūkṣaṃ ca prāyo viṣṭabhya jīryati/
madhuraṃ śītavīryaṃ ca purīṣasya ca bhedanam//
puṣpaṃ grāhi praśastaṃ ca raktapitte viśeṣataḥ/
śreyasī bilvaparṇī ca bilvapatraṃ tu vātanut/
bhaṇḍī śatāvarīśākaṃ balā jīvantikaṃ ca yat//
mukhapriyaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ ca mūtralaṃ trapusaṃ tvati/
viśadaṃ guru śītaṃ ca samabhiṣyandi cocyate//
jīvano bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ kaṇṭhyaḥ śasto rasāyane//
śītāḥ pīnasakartryaśca madhurā gurvya eva ca/
madhuraṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ kharjūraṃ guru śītalam/
kṣaye 'abhighāte dāhe ca vātapitte ca taddhitam//
tarpaṇaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ phalgu guru viṣṭambhi śītalam/
parūṣakaṃ madhūkaṃ ca vātapitte ca śasyate//
sasnehaṃ śleṣmalaṃ śītaṃ vṛṣyaṃ viṣṭabhya jīryati//
dvividhaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ ca madhuraṃ cāmlameva ca/
bilvaṃ tu durjaraṃ pakvaṃ doṣalaṃ pūtimārutam/
tacchuṣkaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ pitte na ca virudhyate//
hikkāśvāse ca kāse ca vamyāṃ varcogadeṣu ca//
gurūṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ rūkṣaṃ keśaghnaṃ ca śamīphalam/
vātaghnaṃ dīpanaṃ caiva vārtākaṃ kaṭu tiktakam/
atha haritavargaḥ--- rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyamārdrakaṃ viśvabheṣajam/
atha madyavargaḥ--- prakṛtyā madyamamloṣṇamamlaṃ coktaṃ vipākataḥ/
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdyaṃ balyaṃ pittāvirodhi ca/
gurvī jīryati viṣṭabhya śleṣmalā tu madhūlikā//
srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ jīrṇaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu rocanam//
atha jalavargaḥ--- jalamekavidhaṃ sarvaṃ patatyaindraṃ nabhastalāt/
śītaṃ śuci śivaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ vimalaṃ laghu ṣaḍguṇam/
śvete kaṣāyaṃ bhavati pāṇḍare syāttu tiktakam/
tathā 'avyaktarasaṃ vidyādaindraṃ kāraṃ himaṃ ca yat//
teṣāṃ bhojye ca bhakṣye ca lehye peye ca śasyate//
hemante salilaṃ snigdhaṃ vṛṣyaṃ balahitaṃ guru/
vibhrānteṣu tu kāleṣu yat prayacchanti toyadāḥ/
salilaṃ tattu doṣāya yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ//
vivarṇaṃ virasaṃ sāndraṃ durgandhaṃ na hitaṃ jalam//
atha gorasavargaḥ--- svādu śītaṃ mṛdu snigdhaṃ bahalaṃ ślakṣṇapicchilam/
guru mandaṃ prasannaṃ ca gavyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ payaḥ//
chāgaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ śītaṃ grāhi payo laghu/
hastinīnāṃ payo balyaṃ guru sthairyakaraṃ param//
jīvanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ sātmyaṃ snehanaṃ mānuṣaṃ payaḥ/
arucau mūtrakṛcchre ca kārśye ca dadhi śasyate//
pīyūṣo moraṭaṃ caiva kilāṭā vividhāśca ye//
athokṣuvargaḥ--- vṛṣyaḥ śītaḥ saraḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇo madhuro rasaḥ/
yathā yathaiṣāṃ vaimalyaṃ bhavecchaityaṃ tathā tathā//
sandhātṛ cchedanaṃ rūkṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ madhu&//
āme soṣṇā kriyā kāryā sā madhvāme virudhyate/
madhvāmaṃ dāruṇaṃ tasmāt sadyo hanyādyathā viṣam//
nānādravyātmakatvācca yogavāhi paraṃ madhu/(=Sū.sū.45.142cd) itīkṣuvikṛtiprāyo vargo 'ayaṃ daśamo mataḥ//
tarpaṇī grāhiṇī ladhvī hṛdyā cāpi vilepikā/
laṅghitānāṃ viriktānāṃ jīrṇe snehe ca tṛṣyatām//
balyāḥ saṃtarpaṇā hṛdyā guravo bṛṃhayanti ca//
akṛtaṃ kṛtayūṣaṃ ca tanuṃ sāṃskārikaṃ rasam/
tarpayanti naraṃ sadyaḥ pītāḥ sadyobalāśca te//
hanyādvyādhīn yavāpūpo yāvako vāḍya eva ca/
bhakṣyā vṛṣyāśca balyāśca paraṃ tu guravaḥ smṛtāḥ//
mṛdupākāśca ye bhakṣyāḥ sthūlāśca kaṭhināśca ye/
rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā balyā rucipradā/
snehanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ vātaghnaṃ saguḍaṃ dadhi//
dravyaṃ mānaṃ ca vijñāya guṇakarmāṇi cādiśet//
guṇakarmāṇi lehānāṃ teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tathā vadet//
śiṇḍākī cāsutaṃ cānyat kālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu/
ātasyaṃ madhurāmlaṃ tu vipāke kaṭukaṃ tathā/
madhuro bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyo balyo majjā tathā vasā/
śleṣmalā madhurā cārdrā gurvī snigdhā ca pippalī/
nistuṣaṃ yuktibhṛṣṭaṃ ca sūpyaṃ laghu vipacayate//
mṛtaṃ kṛśaṃ cātimedyaṃ vṛddhaṃ bālaṃ viṣairhatam/
annānupānaṃ dhātūnāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yanna virodhi ca//

&athānupānakarmaguṇān pravakṣyāmaḥ anupānaṃ tarpayati, prīṇayati, ūrjayati, bṛṃhayati, paryāptimabhinirvartayati, bhuktamavasādayati, annasaṅghātaṃ bhinatti, mārdavamāpādayati, kledayati, jarayati, sukhapariṇāmitāmāśuvyavāyitāṃ cāhārasyopajanayatīti //
sukhaṃ pacati cāhāramāyuṣe ca balāya ca //
dravyāṇi na hi nirdeṣṭuṃ śakyaṃ kātsnryena nāmabhiḥ //
liṅgaḥ pramāṇaṃ saṃskāro mātra cāsmin parīkṣyate //
gurubhakṣyāśca ye sattvāḥ sarve te guravaḥ smṛtāḥ /
vṛṣaṇau carma meḍhraṃ ca śroṇī vṛkkau yakṛdgudam /
gauravaṃ liṅgasāmānye puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ tu lāghavam /
vrīherlājā yathā ca syuḥ saktūnāṃ siddhapiṇḍikāḥ //
ye narāḥ prati tāṃścintyaṃ nāvaśyaṃ gurulāghavam //
divase divase brahma japatyatha dadāti ca //
varṇaḥ prasādaḥ sausvaryaṃ jīvitaṃ pratibhā sukham //
laukikaṃ karma yadvṛttau svargatau yaca vaidikam //
